policy_attestation.statement: An MPC provider confirmed that these six Tori Finance vaults required 2-of-4 transaction approval as of 2026-09-22.

Protocol roles and an operational custody address. Owner / Admin uses a Gnosis Safe with an on-chain quorum. An MPC provider confirmed 2-of-4 transaction approval for six vaults on 2026-09-22. On 2026-09-25 it confirmed 3-of-4 approval for Reward Operator's loss calls. Custodian is an MPC custody address, not a timelock role.
